description: This file defines the Control.Layers class for the Leaflet mapping library, providing UI controls for switching base layers and overlays on a map. It includes methods for adding/removing layers, expanding/collapsing the control, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Layers
classes.description: A control for switching between different base layers and overlays on a Leaflet map, with options for sorting, auto z-index, and UI behavior.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the control with base layers, overlays, and options.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Called when the control is added to the map; sets up layout and event listeners.

methods.name: addTo
methods.description: Adds the control to the specified map.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Removes event listeners when the control is removed from the map.

methods.name: addBaseLayer
methods.description: Adds a base layer option to the control.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay layer option to the control.

methods.name: removeLayer
methods.description: Removes a specified layer from the control.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expands the control UI to show layer options.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapses the control UI.

methods.name: _initLayout
methods.description: Initializes the HTML layout of the control.

methods.name: _getLayer
methods.description: Retrieves layer info by ID.

methods.name: _addLayer
methods.description: Adds a layer to internal list and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: _update
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect current layers and their states.

methods.name: _onLayerChange
methods.description: Handles layer add/remove events to update UI and fire map events.

methods.name: _createRadioElement
methods.description: Creates a radio button input element.

methods.name: _addItem
methods.description: Creates UI elements for a layer and adds to control.

methods.name: _onInputClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on layer checkboxes/radios to add/remove layers.

methods.name: _checkDisabledLayers
methods.description: Disables layer controls based on map zoom level.

methods.name: _expandIfNotCollapsed
methods.description: Expands control if not already collapsed.

methods.name: _expand
methods.description: Expands the control UI.

methods.name: _collapse
methods.description: Collapses the control UI.
